declarations.description:
Reads barcodes and QR codes with the device's camera, as a point of sale, a warehouse app or a ticket check-in
does. It shows the camera with a scan window, reads the picture inside the window several times a second, and fires
`scan` with the code's value and format. By default it stops at the first code and shows it with a **Scan again**
button; `continuous` keeps the camera open and fires for each new code. `beep` sounds on every scan, and the light
button shows on a device whose camera has a torch.

Codes are read by the browser's `BarcodeDetector` where it knows the formats asked for, and otherwise by
`@zxing/library`, an optional peer dependency imported on the first scan. `decoder` replaces both. `formats` narrows
what is read, which is faster and avoids a wrong reading: `formats="ean_13;upc_a"`.

The camera does not open on its own: the user presses **Start camera** (the browser then asks for permission), or
the app calls `start()`, or sets `autostart`. It closes on a scan (unless `continuous`), on `stop()`, and when the
element leaves the page; reading pauses while the scanner is off screen. A camera needs a secure page (HTTPS).
The value of a code is shown as text and never followed as a link: what to do with it is the app's decision.

A handheld (keyboard-wedge) scanner needs no element: it types the code into the focused `c2-text-field`.

slots.description: Replaces the screen shown before the camera starts (an icon, a sentence and the Start camera button). Call `start()` from your own button.
slots.name: idle

slots.description: Replaces the screen shown when the camera or the decoder cannot start. Read the reason from the `camera-error` event.
slots.name: error

slots.description: Replaces the drawing of the scan window; the window's box (`part="window"`) stays, and is the area that is read.
slots.name: window

slots.description: Replaces the screen shown once a code is read (its value, its format and the Scan again button). Read the code from the `scan` event.
slots.name: done

slots.description: Replaces the icon of the light button.
slots.name: torch-icon

slots.description: Replaces the icon of the Switch camera button.
slots.name: switch-icon

slots.description: Action zone under the picture, for the app's own commands: type the code instead, read a picture of it (`scanImage()`), cancel. The events do not bubble: listen on the element itself.
slots.name: actions

members.name: formats
members.description:
The formats to read, as `BarcodeDetector` names them: `qr_code`, `ean_13`, `ean_8`, `upc_a`, `upc_e`, `code_128`,
`code_39`, `code_93`, `codabar`, `itf`, `data_matrix`, `aztec`, `pdf417`. As an attribute, separated by `;`.
Empty reads every format the decoder knows.

members.name: continuous
members.description: Keeps the camera open after a code is read and fires `scan` for each new one, instead of stopping at the first.

members.name: repeatDelay
members.description:
In `continuous` mode, how long in milliseconds a code must be out of the picture before reading it again fires
`scan` again. A code that stays in the window fires once.

members.name: beep
members.description: Sounds a short beep when a code is read.

members.name: torch
members.description: The camera's light. It only turns on while the camera is open and has one; the light button toggles it.

members.name: facing
members.description: The camera to open: `environment` (the back one, the default) or `user` (the front one). Switching camera updates it.

members.name: autostart
members.description: Opens the camera as soon as the element is on the page, without waiting for the Start camera button.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the component. Empty uses the built-in "Barcode scanner".

members.name: streamSource
members.description: Supplies the video stream instead of `getUserMedia`. Set it before the camera starts.

members.name: decoder
members.description: Reads the codes of a picture instead of the built-in decoder (`BarcodeDetector`, else `@zxing/library`).

members.name: run
members.description: Changes whenever scanning starts or stops: a reading that comes back for an older run is dropped.

members.name: seen
members.description: When each code was last in the picture, by format and value: a code still in view does not fire again.

members.name: keepFocus
members.description: Focus was inside the component when its screen changed: it moves to the new screen instead of being lost.

members.name: status
members.description: Where the scanner is: `idle`, `starting`, `scanning`, `done` or `error`. Also a custom state, `:state(scanning)`.

members.name: result
members.description: The last code read, or `undefined` before the first one and after `start()`.

members.name: stream
members.description: The open camera's stream; null while the camera is closed.

members.name: start
members.description: Opens the camera and starts reading. Does nothing while it is open or opening; after a scan, it scans again.

members.name: stop
members.description: Closes the camera and goes back to the idle screen.

members.name: switchCamera
members.description: Switches between the front and the back camera.

members.name: scanImage
members.description:
Reads the codes of a still picture (a file the user chose, a pasted image) with the scanner's decoder and formats.
The first code fires `scan` as one read by the camera does; the promise resolves with every code found.

members.name: lost
members.description: The camera went away while open: unplugged, permission revoked, or taken by another application.

members.name: applyTorch
members.description: Turns the light on or off. A camera without one, or a browser that cannot drive it, leaves it as it is.

members.name: scan
members.description: Reads the picture inside the window once, then schedules the next reading while the camera is open.

members.name: draw
members.description: Draws part of a picture, scaled, and reads its pixels back; `undefined` when they cannot be read (a cross-origin stream).

members.name: inFrame
members.description: A code with its corners moved from the picture the decoder read to the camera's own frame.

members.name: accept
members.description: Takes the codes read from one picture: fires `scan` for each, unless it is a code already in the picture.

members.name: finish
members.description: Closes the camera on the code that was read.

members.name: wakeSound
members.description: Creates the sound output, or wakes one the browser suspended: only allowed while handling a user's action.

events.description: Fired when the camera shows its first picture.
events.name: camera-start

events.description: Fired when the camera cannot start or stops while open, or (`decoder`) when nothing here can read a barcode.
events.name: camera-error

events.description: Fired when a code is read. `detail.value` is its text, `detail.format` its format (`qr_code`, `ean_13`…), `detail.corners` its corners in the camera frame when known.
events.name: scan
